description: A map \(f:A\to B\) is injective if and only if its kernel relation is equality. In particular, a quotient projection is injective exactly when the relation being quotiented is equality.
signature:
Setoid.injective_iff_ker_bot.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → β) :
  Function.Injective f ↔ Setoid.ker f = ⊥
